comments.author: bgnn
comments.why: Hamming lecture showing why intuition fails in higher dimensions.
comments.text: One cannot intuitively think about higher than 3 dimensions. Even for most their intuition is often wrong in 3D space. It's quite accurate for 1D and 2D. Richard Hamming has a whole section lecture to make everyone realize precisely this [1]. This was an eye opener to me. [VIDEO]
